business_summary: Shenzhen Jove Enterprise Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCB) in China and internationally. The company offers multilayer PCBs, which are used in communications and data centers, industrial control, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, semiconductor packaging, and medical electronics; high-density interconnect PCBs to connect various components in small packages; flexible and rigid-flex products, which provide a solution for the integration of multiple rigid circuit board assemblies into a single board; substrate like PCBs for smartphones and tablets; insulated metallic substrate PCBs for power supplies and LED lights; and antenna/RF PCBs for outdoor wireless base stations. It also provides single and double-sided, and multi-layer boards, as well as high-frequency and high-speed boards, metal substrates, rigid-flex boards, high-order HDI boards, and embedded device boards. In addition, the company engages in investing activities. It offers its products to the communications, industrial control, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, semiconductor packaging, and medical electronics industries, as well as communication equipment service providers. The company exports its products to Europe, Asia, the United States, and internationally. Shenzhen Jove Enterprise Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
